facts.fact: Benin's national digital investigations centre (CNIN) reminded on 29 May 2026 that using AI to alter, generate or share a person's image without consent is punishable under article 576 of the Digital Code by up to five years in prison and a fine of FCFA 25 million.

BEN.note: No government use of AI is stated.
No AI tool in a sector system is stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing built in Benin is stated.

facts.fact: Benin's national digital investigations centre (CNIN) said on 29 May 2026 that offences involving AI images are prosecutable under article 576 of the Digital Code.
